question: Inventor of Bluetooth is _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaap Haartsen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Inventor of Bluetooth is **Jaap Haartsen**__.
 
• Jaap Haartsen is a Dutch electrical engineer, researcher, inventor and entrepreneur.
 
• He led the development team that designed and created the Bluetooth in 1994.
 
• He began by taking up a project related to indoor wireless systems and tried to find ways to enable short-range radio connections.
 
• Bluetooth is a wireless technology that uses a radio frequency to share data over a short distance, eliminating the need for wires.
 
• Most Bluetooth devices have a maximum connectivity range of about 30 feet, and that distance is reduced when obstacles (such as a wall) are present.
 
• Presently, Jaap is a wireless expert at Plantronics. In 2015, he was inducted into the National Inventors Hall of Fame.
